# Resource: tfe_organization_membership

Adds or removes a user from an organization.

~> **Note:** This resource requires using the provider with HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise at least as recent as v202004-1.

~> **Note:** This resource cannot be used to update an existing user's email address since users themselves are the only ones permitted to update their email address. If a user updates their email address, configurations using the email address should be updated manually.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.organizationMembership.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        new OrganizationMembership(this, "test", new OrganizationMembershipConfig()
                .email("user@company.com")
                .organization("my-org-name")
                );
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email of the user to add.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization membership ID.
- `userId` (String) The ID of the user associated with the organization membership.
- `username` (String) The username of the user associated with the organization membership.



## Import

tfe_organization_membership can be imported using an identity. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = tfe_organization_membership.test
  identity = {
    id       = "ou-12345678"
    hostname = "app.terraform.io"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

#### Optional

- `hostname` (String)


Resource tfe_organization_membership can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <ORGANIZATION>/<USER EMAIL>
terraform import tfe_organization_membership.test my-org-name/user@example.com

# via <ORGANIZATION MEMBERSHIP ID>
terraform import tfe_organization_membership.test ou-wAs3zYmWAhYK7peR
```
